title: In Splunk SOAR versions below 8.8.0, a user that holds a role with the System Settings edit permission could cause…
description: A vulnerability in Splunk SOAR versions below 8.8.0 allows a user with System Settings edit permission to cause the application to send a stored Elasticsearch password to an attacker-controlled host. This occurs because the application reuses the stored Elasticsearch password when the Search Settings endpoint is changed, without requiring a password replacement.
